title.en: Workshop on Global Health Leadership and Diplomacy: Foundational Level
title.id: Lokakarya Kepemimpinan dan Diplomasi Kesehatan Global: Tingkat Dasar

summary.en: A foundational, one-day workshop on global health diplomacy, negotiation, and leadership. The original invitation is retained as a past-event record; a recap has not been supplied.
summary.id: Lokakarya dasar satu hari tentang diplomasi, negosiasi, dan kepemimpinan kesehatan global. Undangan asli disimpan sebagai catatan kegiatan terdahulu; rangkuman belum tersedia.
